body:
Good morning, my friend!

Did you see the frost on the grass this morning? It sparkles like sugar. Winter is coming.

Mrs. Hannah at the farm needs help getting ready for the cold months. Would you go and help her? Use your map to find the way.
summary: Help Mrs. Hannah pack apples for the winter.
done: The apples are safe for the winter!

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (take the map)
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
